title: Avionics Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=avionics:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day avionics metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on avionics metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It combines what time of day your avionics metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
